newsitem.title: USA: Photocomm posts loss in transition period.
newsitem.headline: Photocomm posts loss in transition period.

text.p: Photocomm Inc Tuesday reported a $1,388,858 loss for its transition period, September 1 through December 31, 1996.

The net loss was largely a result of a $1,300,000 charge, including severance for former company executives, and a cost of goods adjustment of $547,100 for inventories and other related items that have been determined to be slow moving or obsolete.
At the February 3, 1997 board of directors meeting the company changed its fiscal year end to December 31 from August 31.
